messages.subject: inna.tmarginal() gives Error
parts:
Hi, 
I am trying to get summary of marginals of standard deviation of the hyper parameter for a fit from a spatiotemporal model. 

Following this book  , I  tried to get posterior marginals of the standard deviation of hyper parameter as follows:  
marg.stdev.IDmonth<- inla.tmarginal(function(tau) tau^(-1/2),
                                    Model$marginals.hyperpar$`Precision for ID.month`) 
but I am getting this error only for the `Precision for ID.month` parameter. 
Error in if (xx[[1L]] > xx[n]) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In sqrt(tau) : NaNs produced
2: In sqrt(tau) : NaNs produced
> 

All other hyperparameters are fine using this transformation. 
Could you please provide help to overcome this error. 

thanks 
Aminath

there is, I guess, Inf, somewhere, try to convert from the marginal of the
internal parametersisation.

Model$internal.marginals.hyperpar$`Precision for ID.month`

then the function should be function(x) exp(-0.5*x)
